info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Trust Services API
info.description: The Corporate Trust Services API provides access to a suite of functionalities designed to manage corporate trust operations effectively. Users can retrieve detailed information regarding specific corporate trust services and track their statuses. This API serves financial institutions and corporate clients looking to streamline their trust services management, ensuring compliance and operational efficiency. Typical use cases include monitoring trust transactions and accessing service updates, making it a crucial tool for professionals in the banking sector.

get.summary: Retrieve corporate trust service details by ID.
get.description: Fetches comprehensive details about a specific corporate trust service identified by its ID. Utilize this endpoint to access relevant information and insights regarding the service, helping stakeholders make informed decisions.
